clue: Constructed under the leadership of Pericles with sculptors Phidias, Ictinus, and Callicrates.

title: Interstellar Deep-Space Probe
prompt: Which NASA space probe launched in 1977 carried the Golden Record and became the first human-made object to venture into interstellar space?
clue: Now the most distant artificial object from Earth, over 15 billion miles away and still transmitting science data.

title: Concentric Red Bullseye
prompt: Which American retail giant is instantly identified by a bright red circle surrounded by a single concentric red ring?
clue: Introduced in 1962; famous for the slogan 'Expect More. Pay Less.' and the Bullseye dog mascot.

title: Fluid Athletic Checkmark Wing
prompt: Which global athletic footwear and apparel brand is identified by its iconic 'Swoosh' representing the wing of the Greek goddess of victory?
clue: Created in 1971 by graphic design student Carolyn Davidson for just $35; famous for the slogan 'Just Do It'.

title: Towering Golden Archways
prompt: Which global fast food giant is recognized worldwide by a pair of towering yellow parabolic arches forming the letter 'M'?
